name: ssh-music-control
title: SSH Music Control
description: Control the Music app on a remote Mac over SSH
author: slurpyb

commands.name: previous
commands.title: Previous Track
commands.description: Restart the current track, or go to the previous one if at the start

commands.name: play-pause
commands.title: Play/Pause
commands.description: Play or pause music on the remote Mac

commands.name: next
commands.title: Next Track
commands.description: Skip to the next track on the remote Mac

preferences.name: sshDestination
preferences.title: SSH Destination
preferences.description: The Mac that plays your music. Key-based SSH login must already work.
